governed_by: Stage0_PolicyDefinition.md (hard gates) · Stage1_Programming.md §3.2 (exercise facts) · Stage 1 D-03
screened_against: default Current state: every joint at loading stage 1 (Stage 0 §4.1)
method: Pool: every exercise in 12 corpus files — the 8 lifting routines, the popliteus protocol, the 2 mobility protocols and the cardio routine — primaries, alternatives and drills; duplicates merged into one row listing every source. The 2 foam-rolling files were read and left out: tissue release, not exercise (Stage 0 §2.7).

Screen: each row is checked against the hard gates (Stage 0 §0.2: R1–R15) at the default Current state, every joint at loading stage 1 (Stage 0 §4.1). 'joints' records the loading stage each loaded joint needs; status follows: open (all at stage 1), locked (a joint needs more; every joint has a control test, Stage 0 §2.5 · D-61…D-66, so a locked row opens once Harry passes the tests its joints need, R14), excluded (fails a gate in every form).

Unilateral (Stage 0 R12 · D-54): one limb working alone — moving or held, in any plane, against an external load, body weight or its own weight — needs loading stage 3 for every joint of that limb, and a single-leg stance for the stance leg's hip, knee and ankle. Where a drill can run with both limbs together, the row is the bilateral variant (corpus-fixed ✏️). Walking, cycling and swimming stay outside R12 (D-59).
End-range warning (Stage 0 R2 · D-55): a row whose resistance peaks at the end of a joint's range, the soft bend its only margin, carries the warning.
Holds (kind 'hold') count as hypertrophy sets for any muscle (Stage 0 §2.2 · D-58); a plan prescribes them as sets × hold time + seconds in reserve (Stage 0 R16 · D-60).

New rows enter only after Harry confirms them (Stage 1 §3.2 · D-08). Rows marked 'proposed' were added in v1, before D-08; Harry keeps them for later review (A6). Rows marked 'confirmed' entered through D-08: the stage-1 replacements C130–C137 (Q9 · Q10) and the two-arm front raise C138 (T14).

Replacements (Stage 1 D-09): a locked row's replaced_by names the open rows that stand in for it until its joints reach the stage it needs; it then returns to the candidates beside them. An excluded row's replaced_by is permanent. The mirror shows the reverse link as 'Stands in for'.

Cues name the rule they satisfy. Rules that bind every row are not repeated in each: lowering 2–3 s (R25), the in-session abort (R9), left–right balance (R23), soft bend at every joint (R2) unless the row needs a specific cue.

Zones (Stage 1 R26) label where the resistance peaks in the prime mover's range within the gated range; R26's reference labels are used as given; every L is truncated by R1; the triceps has no S slot (R27), so the kickback's S label fills no coverage. Mechanics labels carry basis 'mechanics'.

Compound = multi-joint loading; in a plan only compounds produce harvest (Stage 1 R35). Indirect lists meaningful synergists; an isolation exercise's indirect muscles still collect sets for Stage 0 R19–R21, but give no harvest.
day_after (Stage 0 R21) is computed: each sport whose avoid-the-day-before muscles collect sets in the row (prime or indirect). Drills and conditioning collect no sets.

alt_candidates (Stage 1 R41) is computed for open station exercises: open rows of the same kind and movement pattern that share none of its stations — same prime mover first, then the closest zone, rows without a warning, band variants first among equals. The plan still checks antagonist role and joint angle, and picks two or names the gap.
Plans re-check status against the actual Current state: a row's 'joints' gives the stage each joint needs.
